requirements.text: GET /livez returns HTTP 200 and JSON {status: alive} while the process can answer requests.
GET /catalogue returns HTTP 200, currency GBP and version 1.

POST /quote accepts integer quantity from 1 to 100, integer unitPricePence from 1 to 100000 and delivery standard or express. Subtotal is quantity times unit price. Standard delivery costs 395 pence below a subtotal of 5000 pence and zero at or above 5000. Express delivery costs 795 pence at every subtotal. Return subtotalPence, shippingPence and their sum totalPence.
Invalid quotation inputs return HTTP 400. Other routes and unsupported methods return HTTP 404. Request bodies exceeding 4096 bytes return HTTP 413.
Listen on 0.0.0.0 port 8080. No persistent data, external service or credentials are needed for these requirements.

intendedBehaviour.scope: Stateless GBP delivery quotation, disposable trial inputs only
